description: The patient met the full 2026 Part B deductible earlier in the year, and the notice's deductible-status box says so. Nevertheless the first claim's office visit has its approved amount applied to the deductible again, so the patient is shown owing the whole visit instead of 20% coinsurance.

sources.what: Only one Part B deductible applies per calendar year
The MSN prints the deductible met to date in the page-1 dashboard
